title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 111 James Street in Reidsville, Georgia, as the Senator Jack Hill Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 111 James Street in Reidsville, Georgia, as the "Senator Jack Hill Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a post office building in Reidsville, Georgia, after former state senator Jack Hill.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 111 James Street in Reidsville, Georgia, as the Senator Jack Hill Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021, when it was signed.
